"""

root = Path(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "app").resolve()
with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(base64.b64decode(PATCH_B64)), mode="r:gz") as archive:
    archive.extractall(root)

pubspec = root / "pubspec.yaml"
text = pubspec.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
text = text.replace("version: 1.7.0+8", "version: 1.8.0+9")
text = text.replace("assets/icon/hamoodi_icon.png", "assets/icon/hamoodi_icon.jpg")
if "    - assets/audio/" not in text:
    text = text.replace("    - assets/icon/hamoodi_icon.jpg\n", "    - assets/icon/hamoodi_icon.jpg\n    - assets/audio/\n")
pubspec.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")

(root / "assets" / "icon" / "hamoodi_icon.png").unlink(missing_ok=True)
audio_dir = root / "assets" / "audio"
audio_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

def tone(name, freqs, duration=0.28, rate=22050, volume=0.35):
    frames=[]
    count=int(duration*rate)
    for i in range(count):
        t=i/rate
        f=freqs[min(int(t/duration*len(freqs)), len(freqs)-1)]
        env=min(1.0, t/0.02)*min(1.0, (duration-t)/0.06)
        value=volume*env*math.sin(2*math.pi*f*t)
        frames.append(struct.pack("<h", int(max(-1,min(1,value))*32767)))
    with wave.open(str(audio_dir/name), "wb") as stream:
        stream.setnchannels(1)
        stream.setsampwidth(2)
        stream.setframerate(rate)
        stream.writeframes(b"".join(frames))

tone("tap.wav", [520], 0.12, volume=0.25)
tone("success.wav", [523.25,659.25,783.99], 0.48, volume=0.32)
tone("sparkle.wav", [880,1174.66,1567.98], 0.35, volume=0.25)
tone("pop.wav", [260,180], 0.16, volume=0.30)
tone("wrong.wav", [220,180], 0.28, volume=0.22)
tone("bell.wav", [659.25,987.77], 0.38, volume=0.28)

print("Stage 09 patch applied to", root)
